- **Authority**: active draft [PR #62](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/pull/62), branch investigate/c545d-status-only-monitor-20261120; prior completed HEAD a7940ad46703fb4c8b43e9bb39de0d7b80b3b5a2. Check actual PR HEAD against main docs/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md after handoff commit.
- **Already established separate observations**: previous isolated Windows2022 Combo16 [run #45000301159 SUCCESS](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/actions/runs/45000301159) observed REGISTRY-minus-NOCHANGE default Win32 process-heap reported REGION commitment +221184 B, other three heaps 0 B, PSAPI PrivateUsage +290816 B, BUSY cbData -7792 B. Source callsite ownership, whole-process commit coverage, long-term leak and original Combo256 equivalence were NOT proven. Original preserved FOUR-arm 256 [#44918598339](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/actions/runs/44918598339) final control PrivateUsage +368640 B, BUSY +26262 B, BUSY blocks -9; its 258 cached DisplayName reports each show exactly 32 stored entries and no cardinality growth. Prior three older 256 GIO_VM metrics are VirtualQuery MEM_COMMIT/MEM_PRIVATE not PSAPI PrivateUsage. No improvement percentage changes.
- **NEW pinned source fact**: [GNOME/glib 2.82.4 gmem.c](https://github.com/GNOME/glib/blob/2.82.4/glib/gmem.c) routes g_malloc to libc malloc, g_malloc0 to calloc, g_realloc to realloc, g_free to free; g_free_sized delegates to free_sized when available or free otherwise. [gslice.c](https://github.com/GNOME/glib/blob/2.82.4/glib/gslice.c) routes g_slice_alloc to g_malloc, and slice frees to g_free_sized; GLib's dedicated slice allocator disappeared in 2.76. g_mem_set_vtable in 2.82.4 is merely an unsupported warning stub, not a viable profiling hook. The shared default Windows heap does not by itself reveal whether GLib, GIO, WinRT/COM or CRT callsites own the remaining commitment.
- **NEW TRACE gate finding**: pinned [glib_trace.h](https://github.com/GNOME/glib/blob/2.82.4/glib/glib_trace.h) defines TRACE as a no-op unless HAVE_DTRACE is configured, with feature controlled in GLib Meson. Existing *actual* MSVC Windows2022 [run #45000301159 job137140153472](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/actions/runs/45000301159/job/137140153472) build logged dtrace=false, systemtap=false. Thus gmem.c TRACE(GLIB_MEM_ALLOC/FREE) lines were NOT an enabled Windows allocation-stack capture. Do not falsely recommend g_mem_set_vtable or preexisting TRACE as the missing allocator-owner tool.
